stories.title: The Lakers got flipped?! What we know about the decision to sell, and how the league reacted
stories.summary: After the stunning sale, ESPN spoke to more than a dozen NBA sources to find out why, what it could mean for the league and more.

stories.title: Source: Beck out, derailing rematch vs. Mendoza
stories.summary: Cardinals quarterback Carson Beck won't play in Thursday night's preseason game against the Raiders due to a rib injury sustained in last Thursday's Hall of Fame Game, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Tempers flare at Eagles camp amid testy scuffle
stories.summary: The 11th day of Eagles training camp was defined by a fight between defensive tackle Moro Ojomo and offensive tackle Fred Johnson that could have resulted in injury.

stories.title: Source: PSG lands WC hero Torres on $58M deal
stories.summary: Barcelona forward Ferran Torres will join European champions Paris Saint-Germain after the two clubs reached a deal in principle for around €50 million, a source confirmed to ESPN.

stories.title: Gibbs to honor Kyle Busch by driving M&M's car
stories.summary: Ty Gibbs will honor former NASCAR driver Kyle Busch when he competes in an M&M's paint scheme for next month's Cup Series race at Bristol Motor Speedway.
